reviews.title: Gravel
reviews.text: I have “no gravel” and every time it takes me down gravel.  Aggravating

reviews.title: Support non existent
reviews.text:
I bought in to this app, spent $60 and it keeps telling me my login is not tied into where I purchased (thru Apple).
Sent multiple emails to support and they bounce back saying non deliverable.
Can’t get my money back, so $60 wasted. 
Totally sad about my stupidity, but I forgive them and hope they need the $60 more than I do. 
God Bless.

reviews.title: Crash detection
reviews.text: So I’m on the fence with this app. It does have some cool features and what not but the most concerning is the crash detection so I got in a motorcycle accident on the freeway, the crash detection was on the app running but failed to notify anybody and I was doing about 50 mph I am thankful I’m alive today but my biggest concern what would happen if I was somewhere where there wasn’t a lot of people and I  crashed I’m guessing it would’ve done the same thing. I could’ve been hurt even worse or could’ve been dead so I’m pretty upset that it didn’t do thing.

reviews.title: GPS wants me to drive on water
reviews.text: So don’t know why I pay for this app when it calculates my route it doesn’t take into consideration that there is a body of water and no road.  So it calculates the route as if my Bike could ride on top of the bay.  Developers are idiots for this one.

reviews.title: Meh at best
reviews.text: Seems like a great idea. Unfortunately if you go off your planned route, it just keeps trying to take you back to where you went off. Also, you can't adjust mid route without ending and restarting. I've reached out to customer service multiple times bit have never gotten a response. Waste of money!!

reviews.title: You better have great cell service
reviews.text: Used for a 1000mi trip around norcal this week. The navigation interface is great ... when it works. It's very strange that an app ostensibly for motorcycle trips fails so spectacularly when there's no cell service. "Recalculating ... recalculation failed." And don't even try to edit stops when there's no service, or to download offline maps -- this app can't do either of those essential things. So who is this for? I guess just for people cruising around urban areas with 100% cell coverage. If you are annually going on a long trip, you'd be better off with Apple Maps -- at least it can download offline maps.

reviews.title: Trial only
reviews.text: Don’t get scammed this is a seven day trial only there’s other real free ones out there

reviews.title: Great app bad customer service
reviews.text: Have had the app for over two years recently I couldn’t log back in. I used all my known emails. And cannot access my app. I paid for a year  worth in November. I’m only and few months in. All  my routes and maps and miles I’ve saved were deleted, and my account was deleted. I messaged customer service over a week ago never heard back never even got an email confirmation. This will be the last time I ever use them again. you lost a loyal client I would have been a customer for life.

reviews.title: Couldn’t find🤣
reviews.text:
What a joke. I live in a popular Midwest Great Lakes state where off-roading is universally celebrated all four seasons all year round.

It could find anything with in a 100 mile radius. 

I know of at least a dozen within 30 miles 

And you expect folks to pay for this🤣👍

reviews.title: I wish you would stop…
reviews.text: …with the endless rerouting while you’re riding. After you suggest a rout and people start following it you will then have people go off it and back on it, into neighborhoods that may have three houses just to go around and back in the rout again, strange roads and off-routs just to come out of them again.  Utterly ridiculous app.

reviews.title: Special deals that are impossible to get
reviews.text: For the second time now, Detecht has flashed up on my phone as 50% off annual plans, but can I secure them? No. This useless app wants to charge me £49.99 for 12 months. When the same thing happened last year, I contacted Detecht but was ignored. Time to vote with my wallet. Subscription cancelled.

reviews.title: Bad tracking
reviews.text: App doesn’t track well even in clear sky view of satellites and full bar cell coverage area.   Track jumps across bare land and only shows half of the tracked route even when the trip summary shows that the mileage was actual.

reviews.title: Mid
reviews.text: App is pretty useless they won’t let you use any features unless you pay 60 dollars a year

reviews.title: Too much
reviews.text: Don’t fall for all the clearly fake flashy reviews. $60/year for an app that can be replaced by google and a pen. Greed kills all useful things

reviews.title: Language option
reviews.text: I tried five times to set the language from German to English, and every time it seemed to take, but the app refused to display English. It wouldn't display Spanish either.

reviews.title: Good routes poor directions
reviews.text: I figured I would try to and the route planning was great until it came time to ride the route. Didn’t matter where I started or where I was it continued to tell me to go back to the beginning and start over again and wouldn’t continue the route. Apple Maps took over and got me back on track
